query: My broadband is connected but websites fail with DNS lookup errors. The router shows connected and a DNS test cannot resolve domain names.

knowledge.title: Broadband DNS lookup failure investigation
knowledge.body:
Scope: fibre_broadband; support category: broadband_dns
Diagnostic gate: A support agent confirms that the broadband link is connected but the configured DNS resolver fails domain-name lookups.
Only if that finding is established: Restore the validated DNS resolver configuration on the broadband router, then verify domain-name resolution and website access.
Restriction: Do not factory-reset the router, change billing settings or claim a repair before DNS lookup verification succeeds.

DNS_TRAIN_A: My broadband is connected but the router DNS resolver cannot look up website names.
Internet over broadband is up, yet the configured DNS server fails name resolution.
The broadband router says connected but DNS queries time out for all website domains.
My home broadband has a DNS resolver error while the physical connection remains active.
Domain-name lookups fail on the configured broadband DNS server despite a working link.
The router is online but reports DNS resolution failure for internet sites.
The broadband session works but the assigned DNS resolver cannot answer queries.
I need help with DNS failures on a connected home broadband router.
DNS_TRAIN_B: After changing the broadband router settings, DNS domain lookups stopped working.
Website names stopped resolving when I edited the DNS server on my broadband router.
Broadband stays connected but a wrong DNS resolver setting prevents website access.
I entered a new DNS address in the router and now home internet domain lookup fails.
The broadband router has an invalid DNS server setting and websites do not resolve.
Changing the router DNS configuration broke name resolution although broadband is online.
The broadband link is active but my edited DNS settings cannot resolve internet domains.
Home broadband domain-name resolution stopped after a DNS configuration change.

DNS_DEV_C: My broadband connection is alive but every DNS lookup returns a resolver error.
The fibre broadband link is up and name resolution fails with the assigned DNS service.
I can connect to broadband but cannot resolve website domain names through DNS.
A DNS check fails to resolve hostnames despite an active broadband session.
My connected broadband router cannot obtain answers for DNS name requests.
Broadband connectivity remains active but hostname resolution reports DNS errors.
DNS requests do not receive answers on our otherwise connected home broadband.
Website hostnames fail DNS resolution with the broadband router still connected.
